technical.summary: Oversold bounce signals present but lack confluence; price remains below key moving averages with weak trend structure and no bullish momentum confirmation.

fundamental.summary: MCHP shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signal, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk within 49 days—fundamentals lack bullish catalysts.

risk.summary: Severe macro headwinds: VIX at crisis levels (405.28), flat yield curve signals recession risk, FOMC event in 1 day creates imminent volatility, and earnings in 49 days add binary event risk.

debate.key_bull_argument: Oversold RSI_9, StochRSI cross-up, and Williams %R oversold create a technical bounce setup with extreme fear sentiment (10/100) offering contrarian opportunity near support at 53.95.
debate.key_bear_argument: Price remains below all major moving averages with no bullish momentum confirmation (MACD bearish, OBV flat, no crossovers), macro environment is severely unfavourable (VIX crisis, FOMC in 1 day, earnings in 49 days), and fundamental score is critically weak with zero insider/institutional conviction.
